items.t: All that glisters is not gold.
To thine own self be true, and it must follow, as the night the day, thou canst not then be false to any man.
The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves, that we are underlings.
Our doubts are traitors, and make us lose the good we oft might win, by fearing to attempt.
Brevity is the soul of wit.
Better three hours too soon than a minute too late.
If music be the food of love, play on.
Love all, trust a few, do wrong to none.
We are such stuff as dreams are made on, and our little life is rounded with a sleep.
Though this be madness, yet there is method in it.
Government of the people, by the people, for the people, shall not perish from the earth.
Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth on this continent a new nation, conceived in liberty.
Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
Well done is better than well said.
Lost time is never found again.
A penny saved is a penny earned.
Energy and persistence conquer all things.
Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
The only way to have a friend is to be one.
Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.
If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
It is not enough to be busy; so are the ants. The question is, what are we busy about?
Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear.
Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
Experience is simply the name we give our mistakes.
Slow and steady wins the race.
United we stand, divided we fall.
No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
It is easy to be brave from a safe distance.
Look before you leap.
Honesty is the first chapter in the book of wisdom.
It is hard to fail, but it is worse never to have tried to succeed.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
Curiouser and curiouser!
Why, sometimes I have believed as many as six impossible things before breakfast.
It is no use going back to yesterday, because I was a different person then.
It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness.
No one is useless in this world who lightens the burden of it for anyone else.
There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.
If there is no struggle, there is no progress.
The secret of success is constancy to purpose.
Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
To strive, to seek, to find, and not to yield.
It is better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.
The world is so full of a number of things, I am sure we should all be as happy as kings.
If you can keep your head when all about you are losing theirs, you will be a man, my son.
All warfare is based on deception.
Supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting.
If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles.
Well begun is half done.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Practice makes perfect.
Actions speak louder than words.
Fortune favors the bold.
Where there is a will, there is a way.
The best way of avenging thyself is not to become like the wrong doer.
A rolling stone gathers no moss.
The early bird catches the worm.
Rome was not built in a day.
